newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-West Indies win toss and bat against Territory.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-West Indies win toss and bat against Territory.

text.p: West Indies captain Courtney Walsh has opted to bat after winning the toss for the limited overs tour match against a Northern Territory Invitation XI.
Western Australia captain and wicketkeeper Adam Gilchrist is leading an Invitation team that also includes South Australia's former test batsman Greg Blewett.
Master batsman Brian Lara returned for West Indies after sitting out the tourists' nine-wicket victory over Western Australia in a three-day match over the weekend.
West Indies will face Australia in the first test in Brisbane, starting on November 22.

Northern Territory Invitation XI - Darren Lehmann, Greg Blewett, Justin Langer, Adam Gilchrist (captain), Darren Treumer, Shaun Williams, Mark Hatton, Damian Kulmar, Sean Cary, Andrew Bichel, Ben Southam.
West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Robert Samuels, Adrian Griffith, Brian Lara, Jimmy Adams, Roland Holder, Courtney Browne, Kenneth Benjamin, Courtney Walsh (captain), Patterson Thompson, Ian Bishop.
